messages.title: ♪ Welcome to TimeMSM v1
messages.message:
The first PC private server since MSM Sandbox.

Everything here is rebuilt from real captured 5.5.0 server data — every island unlocked, every island skin owned, instant hatching and breeding, maxed castles, and currency that never runs out.

No timers. No waiting. No paywalls. Just monsters.

Thanks for playing. ♪
